text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Nothing else left to buy. It's almost time 
for training, so I'd better head back.

text_block_list.name: Furniture Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Recommended for restless sleepers! It's 
our new low-resilience urethane body 
pillow! Feel free to try it out~!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(If I use this pillow, I wonder if I'll 
stop falling onto the floor while 
sleeping...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(No, I mustn't give in to temptation...! 
If I keep watching, I'll be late for 
training.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(A knight... shall never surrender to a 
body pillow!)

text_block_list.name: Furniture Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Due to overwhelming popularity, this is 
the very last body pillow! We have no 
plans for a restock at this time~!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ngh! Did you say... the last one...?! 
Kgh...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, it fits so wonderfully... Let us 
try some other poses as well...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal succumbed to the temptation of 
her body pillow and was late for 
training."
